title: billing-profile
description: A tenant's billing identity (issue #93): legal name, billing contact reference, tax id, and default currency. This is metadata storage only - OMES never sends email itself; `billing_contact_ref` is an opaque reference (e.g. an AWCMS user/contact id) awcms-one resolves through its own provider-neutral email boundary, not an inline address OMES emails directly.
